v0.32.0.title: Sharper on every screen
v0.32.0.summary: Huge thanks to @zackburnley (u/electricpenguin7) for this one. He noticed the Android app looked low-res and sent one line from the debug log (#320). That report led to sharper drawing on every platform: the game now renders at your screen's own resolution on Android, iOS, the web and desktop, supports 120 Hz phones, and picks Render resolution and Frame rate settings that suit your hardware. On a phone, Native at 120 Hz uses more battery; the last image shows how to trade a little sharpness for battery life.
